summary: Practise DPDP data mapping, consent, DPIAs and breach response. Build practical compliance work products. Explore the five-day course.
lede: DPDP compliance training helps privacy, legal, compliance, IT governance, HR, and operations professionals turn data-protection duties into documented controls. Participants practise mapping personal-data flows, maintaining consent records, drafting privacy notices, handling data requests, assessing processing through DPIAs, and preparing breach-response procedures. Practical exercises use templates and spreadsheet-based registers, while AI-assisted data discovery is introduced at an overview level rather than as a technical implementation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, document, govern, or respond to personal-data processing under the DPDP Act.
prerequisites: Recommended: working familiarity with privacy, legal, compliance, information security, HR, or IT governance responsibilities. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with access to Word and Excel if you want to complete the document and register exercises digitally; no specialist software is required.
